description: Source code for the CourseSchedulingTool class, which manages scheduling courses, validating input, deleting existing schedules, and creating new course schedule documents within an ERPNext education module.

classes.name: CourseSchedulingTool
classes.description: A Document subclass that provides methods to schedule courses, validate data, delete existing schedules, and create new course schedule entries.

methods.name: schedule_course
methods.description: Creates course schedules based on parameters, handling rescheduling and error collection.

methods.name: validate_mandatory
methods.description: Ensures all required fields are filled.

methods.name: validate_date
methods.description: Checks that the course start date is not after the end date.

methods.name: delete_course_schedule
methods.description: Deletes existing course schedules within a date range and matching the specified day.

methods.name: make_course_schedule
methods.description: Creates a new course schedule document for a given date.
